question: What approval instances and completed steps are recorded for this record?

steps.name: instances
steps.soql: SELECT Id, Status, SubmittedBy.Name, LastActor.Name, CreatedDate, ElapsedTimeInDays FROM ProcessInstance WHERE TargetObjectId = '{record}' ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT {limit}

steps.name: steps
steps.soql: SELECT ProcessInstanceId, StepStatus, Actor.Name, OriginalActor.Name, CreatedDate, ElapsedTimeInDays FROM ProcessInstanceStep WHERE ProcessInstanceId IN ({@instances.Id}) ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {instances.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: Only exposed and visible approval history is included. Pending requests are not completed steps.
Both steps are bounded; a timeline can be incomplete. Comments are deliberately not selected.
